summary: McKesson Corporation filed an 8-K reporting entry into a new $5.0 billion five-year senior unsecured revolving credit facility (maturing April 2031) that replaces its existing $1.0 billion 364-day facility and $4.0 billion five-year facility. No borrowings were outstanding at termination. The facility includes a $4.5 billion multicurrency sublimit and a financial covenant requiring a total debt-to-Consolidated EBITDA ratio not exceeding 4.25x, with a temporary step-up to 4.75x after certain acquisitions. This is a routine refinancing of committed credit lines, not a special-situation event.
